title: Freya and the Echo
author: Yara Dunmore
blurb: Quentin Pemberton, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
